T.topic_fa: بازطراحی‌ای که برند را نامرئی کرد: مشتری بسته را نمی‌خواند، می‌شناسد
T.topic_en: The redesign that made the brand invisible: shoppers don't read your pack, they recognise it
T.central_tension_fa: همه فکر می‌کنیم بسته‌بندی تازه و مدرن یعنی فروش بیشتر؛ ولی وقتی نشانه‌ای را که مشتری با آن پیدایمان می‌کرد پاک می‌کنیم، او از کنار ما رد می‌شود. طرحی که جایزه برد، قفسه را باخت.
T.central_tension_en: We assume a fresh, modern pack sells more; but erase the cue people used to find you and they walk right past. The design that won the award lost the shelf.
T.working_hook_fa: یک پرتقال و یک نی. همین را پاک کردند و فروش افتاد.
T.working_hook_en: They swapped an orange for a glass of juice. Shoppers stopped finding it.

key_sources.claim: Caruso, Journal of Retailing and Consumer Services 2026 (US/UK household shoppers survey): redesign works when perceived modernity rises without removing recognisable cues; removing colours, logos or layout can reduce familiarity and purchase intent; 58% of marketers name modernisation as the main purpose of their latest pack redesign; modernise only when likeability has measurably declined.
Tropicana's new carton (glass of juice replacing orange with a straw): unit sales -20%, dollar sales -19% from Jan 1 to Feb 22, 2009 (IRI), revenue down about $33M; dropped the new pack on Feb 23.

Bahlsen's 2021 redesign (Auge) won D&AD, dropped product imagery and the signature blue; sales -11.8% in Jan-May 2023 per CEO (Lebensmittelzeitung); inflation also cited by commentators; new rebrand planned.

T.framing_note: The idea is evergreen: protect distinctive brand assets when you modernise. The 2026 Ehrenberg-Bass paper is the spark, but it dates from April: never call it 'new research' on screen. On screen: one number at most (Tropicana 20%, 'in under two months'). Bahlsen: say the award-winning redesign was followed by a sales drop and a planned re-redesign; do not claim the design alone caused it (inflation). Close with the practical rule: before redesigning, list what customers actually recognise you by (colour, shape, symbol) and keep it; change only what is not recognised. Never show the Tropicana or Bahlsen logos as AI-generated objects; real brand imagery only from owner uploads, framed and credited. No mention of any Gulf location.
